split_rule: 1000 recordings per class, stratified 800/100/100; all 16 frames of a recording stay together.
selection: Maximum validation top1, earliest epoch on ties; no test-monitored selection.
precision: Historical CIFAR10-DVS native AMP + TET recipe; validation and final evaluation both use CUDA autocast and half inputs. No claim of matching the FP32 protocol of other datasets.
test_policy: All 20 complete runs and selected checkpoint hashes must be frozen before each selected checkpoint is evaluated once on the internal test. Smoke tests use validation only.
reporting: All five paired seeds; mean and sample SD ddof=1; paired differences; failures retained. No automatic significance claim.
historical_limitations: Dataset previously used in exploratory development. Resplitting and fresh initialization do not erase historical test-guided choices. Do not pool the older 9000/1000 results with this 8000/1000/1000 protocol.
resume_policy: Skip only already completed verified jobs. An interrupted training job is not auto-resumed: RNG/data-loader state is not fully restored by legacy checkpoints. Never silently restart or change its seed.
safety: One independent job per selected idle GPU; no distributed training, no process killing, no automatic deletion. Existing/failed outputs are preserved. No test retries after a started test without explicit review.
